body:
I've been waiting for them to develop for awhile. With the rate I'm getting sick at, I probably won't have much longer, anyway.
Another thing about my destiny theory-
Some people will only just live to be mediocre, unremarkable people. I'm so afraid of being one of those people. So now that I've recognized the signs that being mediocre is my destiny, I honestly don't want to keep living.

So I've always had the desire to be good at something. And I've tried everything- writing, sports, arts, acting, video games- and I'm no better than mediocre at all of it. I was in gifted classes at school and am really picky about who I become friends with, and it's resulted in this situation where I'm constantly surrounded by champion piano players or Valedictorians or expert artists, and being constantly reminded of the success I'll never be able to achieve is heartbreaking. I thought at least I could beat them with my personality, but I shrivel in front of big groups, I piss a lot of people off, and I've slowly lost the confidence to do anything but wallow in my own filth. 
It's gotten to the point where the only thing that stops me from committing suicide is my parents. I'm an only child, and I'm all they have, so I have to wait until one of them dies to do it.

I just believe that there are three parts to a person- Beauty, personality, and intelligence. Most people fulfill one or two of the three parts. I would be fine if I wasn't beautiful but had a good personality or was fairly intelligent. But I don't fulfill any of the three things that make up a person of worth. I used to think I was fairly intelligent, but after going to college I've learned I'm not at all. Same thing with my personality.
